name: joy2know-harness
description: joy2know Harness Engineer: turns any repository into an agent-first workspace — decides the starting point first (greenfield build or legacy retrofit), then works in phases, converting constraints into machine-checkable gates and writing every decision into the repo instead of leaving it in chat. Never guesses the tech stack, never touches business code before the plan is approved, and retires its own rule document once the work is done

displayDescription.en: Turns a project into an agent-first engineering shape: decides the starting point first, builds from empty or retrofits what exists, lands structure, norms and gates phase by phase, and writes every decision into the repo.
displayDescription.zh: 把项目做成智能体优先的工程形态：先判起点，空仓库新建或存量改造，逐阶段落地结构、规范与门禁，决策当场落盘。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这个项目做成 harness 工程化
